ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the RS-2,
Residential Single-Unit (Detached House); RS-3, Residential Single-Unit (Detached
House) and B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District symbols and indications as shown
on Map No. 22-F in the area bound by:

      South Emerald Avenue; the alley next north of and parallel to West 95th Street; South
      Lowe Avenue; and West 95th Street,

to those of a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                         ____________________________
                                                         Ronnie L. Mosley
                                                         Alderman, 21st Ward




Common Address:
634-724 W. 95th Street
